name: Center-to-Center Approximation
definition: An approximation to the integral of propagated incoming radiance that replaces the integration over the support of Gaussian surfels with a single ray connecting the central points of the surfels, reducing variance and computational cost while relaxing the dependency between geometry and material optimization.
summary: Center-to-Center Approximation estimates light transport in Gaussian surfels by replacing expensive double integrals with single rays between centers, reducing variance and cost.
